title: Earn $15,000? HDB now says yes

lines.say: You and your partner earn 15,000 dollars a month. Until August, that was too much for an HDB loan.
lines.cap: *$15,000* a month: too much, until August

lines.say: From 24 August 2026, the household ceiling went from 14,000 to 16,000 dollars.
That covers BTO flats, HDB loans and CPF housing grants for resale flats.
The Enhanced CPF Housing Grant ceiling stays at 9,000.
Your income is assessed when you apply for your HFE letter.
So if you were turned down before, it may be worth checking again.

source: HDB, from 24 Aug 2026. Average gross monthly household income.
caption:
You and your partner earn $15,000 a month? Until August, that was too much for an HDB loan. 🏠

From 24 August 2026, the household income ceiling went from $14,000 to $16,000. That covers BTO flats, HDB loans and CPF housing grants for resale flats. The Enhanced CPF Housing Grant ceiling stays at $9,000.

Your income is assessed when you apply for your HFE letter. If you were turned down before, it may be worth checking again.
